subject: Burnout 3 Servers
author: ZombieTron
body:
Apparently they have been down for a little while now, I'm assuming it is due to the download version and EA working on it as they are expecting more than a dozen people being online at any one time like there is now. But when BO3 players have contacted EA customer support the only information they have been given is that the server is closed?

I did say that I would ring EA Customer Support yesterday, as I have a long standing relationship with them. However I got caught up in watching The Unit instead.

I will endeavor to call them this evening to see if I can get to the bottom of what they are doing to the servers, and to catch up as it's been a while since I had to ring them! 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---
